about: I'm a B.Tech student in Digital Transformation at Atria University. I work on machine learning and AI systems: classification and regression pipelines, data analysis, and apps that use LLMs to do real work.

Most of my work is in Python with Scikit-learn, Pandas and LangChain. Lately I've been building agentic systems: multi-agent setups, RAG, and tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I'm comfortable with Linux, SQL, Git and Bash, and I know the basics of MLOps.
I'm especially interested in applying ML and agentic AI to financial technology and systematic trading.
